summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @servicetitan/carto-charts-react@0.0.8 ships an obfuscated preinstall script (setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases for the host platform, extracts it to a temp directory, chmod +x's the binary, and immediately executes a bundled 727KB obfuscated CJS payload (math_init.js) with that alternate runtime. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are transformed with obfuscator.io-style techniques (shifted string arrays, hex-named identifiers, custom-alphabet decoders, per-function property maps that hide simple literals like "unzip", "--version", "ldd", and the GitHub URL). package.json declares "files":["dist"], yet setup.mjs and math_init.js are shipped at the tarball root outside the declared files surface. The alternate-runtime-dropper pattern (invoking a second, non-Node runtime at install time) bypasses Node-based install scanners; the payload's contents cannot be audited by the installer before execution. A React wrapper around echarts-for-react has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime or execute an obfuscated bundle on install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
